nom: Dickinson's Witch Hazel Hydrating Toner with Rosewater

segments.oily: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily, including one who says she has dealt with it her whole life, report noticeably less oil throughout the day and recommend the toner especially for oily or large-pored skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls her skin chronically on the dry side, report it helps with moisture retention and soothes after cleansing, though one says her skin still feels somewhat dry after use despite less redness and fewer breakouts.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report their skin looks and feels noticeably better, including one whose combination skin was prone to redness and blemishes and improved enough that she can go without makeup, and another who saw dark spots lighten.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who calls it extremely sensitive, report no burning or stinging and say it succeeded where harsher toners had caused burning or peeling; one reviewer with very sensitive, irritated skin, however, reports it burned badly, and another with sensitive skin describes a tingling sensation on application that did not lead to breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 50 report their skin tone has evened out and looks noticeably better than in past years, with fading of age spots.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with aging or age-spot-prone skin, including some over 50, report a more even skin tone and fading age spots with regular use, describing their skin as looking noticeably better than in previous years.
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers describe the toner as hydrating and non-drying, several saying it retains more moisture than other toners or plain witch hazel; one reviewer with chronically dry skin, however, still finds her face somewhat dry after use even though other symptoms improved.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with redness-prone or combination skin report the toner calms redness and does not irritate, including one whose redness-prone skin improved enough that she can go without makeup; one reviewer, however, reports the fragrance made her skin break out in red bumps, and another without sensitive skin still noticed mild stinging.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, age spots, scarring, or hyperpigmentation and a more even overall skin tone with regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report clearer skin with fewer breakouts after regular use, including one whose skin became the clearest it had been in over a year after other treatments had failed; one reviewer, however, says the fragrance made her break out in red bumps.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who says she dealt with it her whole life, report noticeably less oil throughout the day, and a couple of others note their pores appear smaller after use.

aspects.libelle: Bottle or cap often arrives broken
Fragrance can trigger irritation in some users
Scent and formula reportedly vary between batches
Generous bottle size for the price
Alcohol-free claim disputed by some reviewers
Doubles as a body or underarm freshener

extraits.texte: This stuff is beyond amazing! I have only been using it for a few days now, and between switching off with their Pore Perfecting Toner (I use this in the morning before applying makeup and the Pore Perfecting Toner at night after removing my makeup) I am 50 years old and I swear it has taken 10 years off my skin! I use them with exfoliating cotton rounds on my face, neck and chest areas. It has evened out my skin tone, my aging spots are already starting to fade, and I am glowing! I can see why people rave about this stuff and swear by it! I can see why the smell might bother some people, but I don't mind it. I also have pretty oily skin, and this also helps with that, as well. Don't hesitate to give this a try! I only wish I had started using it much sooner!

I have dealt with oily skin my entire life. It was hard to find products that wouldn't create more oil. I was the girl who would use those oil papers daily. It was bad. Since using Dickinson's Witch Hazel Hydrating Toner with Rosewater, my skin has had way less oil. I use it every morning and sometimes at night depending on how oily my skin is in the evening. You don't need a lot for your skin. I definitely recommend the toner, especially for those who have oily skin.

Ok folks! This stuff is legit. I went from perfect skin to horrible awful skin for the last year. Have tried so many things. Special soaps, homemade stuff, doctor prescribed cream along with medication, masks, toners, several different lotions, face washes...it has been a brutal battle and not to be overly dramatic, has really affected(negatively) many aspects of my life. Thank God for the mask mandate, I was able to cover the mess. HOWEVER, the reviews for this toner and the research I did on it sold me so I tried it. ONE WEEK later my skin is the clearest it's been in over a year. It's so soft, my pores are smaller, I feel like it's helping with my scarring and discoloration too. I have extremely sensitive skin as well. This product does not sting my eyes does not sting my face leaves no sticky residue. I really hope I'm not jinxing myself, this is a incredible product and has worked quite quickly. Definitely worth a try! Good luck.

Why didn't I find this sooner! I've acne-prone, dry, splotchy ageing skin. This helps soothe after I clean, tones down redness and keeps the spots at bay. Also BRILLIANT as a deodorant. I put some under my armpits at night, let it dry, then put on mild deodorant. Typically by morning I'd smell sweaty, but this product keeps my pits stink - free. Some days i just use it by itself a couple of times a day in place of deodorant. Love it! Also bonus points for it being alcohol free.

Meine empfindliche Haut verträgt das Gesichtswasser sehr gut. Ich benutze es abends und morgens dann ein Rosenwasser. Seitdem hat sich meine zu Rötungen und Unreinheiten neigende Mischhaut so extrem verbessert, dass ich mittlerweile sogar ohne Make-up das Haus verlassen kann. Daran wäre früher überhaupt nicht zu denken gewesen. Meine Ü50-Haut ist heute wesentlich besser als in jüngeren Jahren.

I have very sensitive irritated skin and bought this thinking this would give some relief. Advertised as “alcohol free” but the 3rd ingredient listed is Phenoxyethanol, which is literally a type of ether alcohol. Beware to those with irritated skin because this BURNS. Wish I would’ve read the ingredients first because this was a waste. But to be fair, there is a nice rose scent so if you don’t mind the “skin on fire” burning sensation then this is the product for you.

For what it’s worth I’ve tried everything. It seemed like the older I got my skin kept getting worse. Well not any better. I’ve been using this once in the morning and again before bed for a few months now. My face isn’t as red or broken out so I’m pleased with it. My face is somewhat dry after using it but it’s always been on the dry side.
